### Redeemed to Perpetuate the Name
Author: Jared C. Wilson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/article/redeemed-to-perpetuate-the-name-3/
Passage: Ruth 4:9-10
Points:
- Boaz was motivated by a genuine desire to honor God in his care for Ruth and Naomi.
- By willingly preserving the name and inheritance of deceased relatives, Boaz displayed selfless faith in a lawless era.
- While the unnamed nearer relative protected his own interests and was forgotten, Boaz is remembered in the ancestry of Jesus Christ.
- Believers are redeemed not merely for personal comfort, but so that Christ's name and lordship will be magnified throughout the world.

### Who is Our Close Relative?
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-september-9-2022.html
Passage: Ruth 4:6
Points:
- The closer kinsman who was unable and unwilling to redeem symbolizes Adam.
- Every human shares a lineage in Adam, inheriting spiritual ruin and helplessness.
- While human lineage provides no salvation, Boaz foreshadows Jesus as the willing and able Redeemer.
- Christians are called to worshipfully reflect on how Christ's redemptive work overcomes the legacy of Adam.
